Queen of the Reborn Nile

In ancient Egypt, Nefer, a noblewoman by the Nile, originally had a bright marriage prospect, but she married Seneb, who came from a poor family, for love. She spent all her family wealth to help him become a royal scribe, only to find that Seneb had fallen for the young princess Tanet. To get rid of Nefer, Seneb didn't hesitate to push her into the Nile. She died in the raging river, full of hatred. When she opened her eyes again, her soul had descended into the body of Taweret—the grand princess who had just been assassinated by her stepmother Tai on her way back home, the pharaoh's only heir. Looking at her brand-new hands, Nefer was sure this was a second chance granted by the goddess Isis. She chose to enter the palace as a princess. This time, she wouldn’t bow to anyone.
